notes.title: The Chuusotsu Are Back!
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1148930/Chuusotsu_15th_Graduation_The_Moving_Castle/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36565403/3517a64515121454de97343e568e8828b86460bc.png[/img][/url]
Arue and her quirky Chuusotsu crew are back!

Can Arue survive her first trip to a certain doujin event in the Big Site? Find out today!

This is the worldwide premiere of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1148930/Chuusotsu_15th_Graduation_The_Moving_Castle/]Chuusotsu! 1.5th Graduation: the Moving Castle[/url], a sequel to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/630870/Chuusotsu_1st_Graduation_Time_After_Time/]Chuusotsu! 1st Graduation: Time After Time[/url] by Studio Beast.

The game supports English and Japanese languages, and directly continues the story of the first game.

Chuusotsu! 1st Graduation and all DLC are also a record -40% off this week, and owners of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/7049/Graduation_Bundle/]Graduation Bundle[/url] can get an extra -10% discount.

Welcome aboard the Chuusotsu train!
